This tutorial discusses the different choice processes and the corresponding coding processes.

# Setup

First, let us load the mxd package.

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(mxd)
```

# Coding processes

Currently, mxd provides a total o 7 different coding processes, namely:

-   `best-worst`: best-worst coding (also known as marginal coding, see [@aizaki2023]). This is the coding process implemented in Lighthouse Studio [@lighthouse2020]. Participants make the best and the worst choices from the same set.
